#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

branch=$(git branch --all --color=never \
  | grep -v HEAD \
  | sed 's/^[* ] //;s|remotes/origin/||' \
  | sort -u \
  | fzf --preview 'git log --oneline --color=always -20 {}' --height=60%)

[ -n "$branch" ] && git checkout "$branch"
summary_zh: fzf 互動切換 git 分支含 log preview
